contributorReview.body:
Review the replacement for Ruff #30898: published `0af5b7f2e` → proposed `88b15ebe27`. Both commits use upstream `3f63e8b36` as their base.

The revision handles `NotImplemented` in ordinary and reflected arithmetic as well as augmented assignments. Existing successful-result annotations and parameter-based fallback remain supported. Direct method calls retain their original return types. Callability errors block reflection; methods on two operands with the same known runtime class are not retried as reflected calls.

The original two regression fixtures fail on published `0af5b7f2e`. The candidate passes core 86, semantic 539 (35 ignored), IDE 1,964, all 532 default Markdown tests, canonical hooks, formatting and strict Clippy. [Qualification](https://app.buildbuddy.io/invocation/f6a9e652-fe1f-4866-b3f2-251ac7fa181d); [published-head controls](https://app.buildbuddy.io/invocation/dd07a677-6774-4678-89c6-55ccc1bb30fb).

contributorReview.summary: Recommend the bounded three-type revision, accepting the documented enum/subclass precision tradeoff. Authorization covers preparation and Bazel/RBE qualification; source publication requires a later review.
contributorReview.body:
Authorize preparing and qualifying a revision of PR #30761 covering `str`, `bytes`, and `int` together? The published string-only head remains `8a2c814d3c7b236dee569aa55983ca2d06b84d0a`. No broader source has been prepared or qualified.

Recommendation: use the existing post-insertion normalization for these matching builtin fallbacks:

| Union | Proposed result |
|---|---|
| `(str & ~AlwaysFalsy) \| Literal[""]` | `str` |
| `(bytes & ~AlwaysFalsy) \| Literal[b""]` | `bytes` |
| `(int & ~AlwaysFalsy) \| Literal[0]` | `int` |

Retain `LiteralString` as empty-string coverage. Match only a single builtin core with the sole `~AlwaysFalsy` exclusion. Preserve extra constraints, subclass-specific cores, alias and cycle safeguards, and nonempty/nonzero fallback precision. Keep `False` distinct from integer zero; a `False`-only fallback does not trigger integer widening. Existing boolean normalization needs no separate extension.

This is deliberate widening, not type equivalence. Broad results admit falsy subclass and enum values and lose some later narrowing. Broad `int` also admits `False` and zero-valued `IntEnum` members. The global union normalizer affects explicitly written intersection annotations as well as inferred expressions.

[Carl supports weighing this precision tradeoff and agrees that bytes and integers should be considered together](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/30761#issuecomment-7140743217). [Alex identifies lost enum narrowing and requests the same consistency](https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/pull/30761#issuecomment-7133051265). The demonstrated split-overload benefit is specific to strings; bytes and integers extend consistency. Both independent technical assessments support this bounded plan.

If authorized, extend the existing Boolean OR fixture for bytes/int empty-or-zero fallbacks and nonempty/nonzero controls, reuse existing order and truthiness coverage, and qualify through Bazel/RBE. Present the qualified commit and actual range-diff for separate approval before updating the PR.

This decision authorizes preparation and qualification only. It does not approve source publication, a reply, closure, or merge. The separate #30898 amendment `88b15ebe` remains pending and unchanged.

False results are cached only when complete; true certified existence may be cached. Next: Review cache eligibility and source-edit lifetime separately from upstream cached type relations #30483. Existing semantic-index tracked-key fix is a different producer.

Visit whole relation consequences before terminal success or pruning. Pending derived relations run positively with their fuel context and retain witness scopes through original continuation under either outer polarity. They bypass plain path memo/prune callbacks and restore original edge fuel before continuing. Next: Require correlated witness and fuel regression.

Prune irrelevant subtrees only after a three-state existence proof. Visible inferable support closes over active path and declaration-validation constraints. Irrelevant subtrees are skipped only when certified satisfiable, rejected only when refuted, and mark family incomplete otherwise. Root terminal validation still attributes failures only after no certified path. Next: Review optimization against quantified cross-variable dependencies and ordinary no-quantifier performance.

Share traversal with explicit memo, prune and terminal callbacks. Atomic traversal separates reusable cache/prune/process callbacks, parameterizes polarity and passes original relation/source-order to the walker. Never-cache/never-prune callbacks serve scopes whose continuations carry extra ownership. Atomic negative traversal delays edge union construction. Next: Verify terminal budgeting and callback ownership through scoped traversal.

Keep positive witnesses live through the outgoing continuation. Existential holding edge visits outgoing continuation then body positively under private locals and their declarations. Even negated outer nodes do not negate existential body. New derived locals get validations beyond root support; Boolean proof walks logical domains, while candidate inference preserves family/preference selection for later validation. Uncertain positive branch needs no body proof. Next: Use independent and nested quantifier regressions.

Reject existential existence only after a whole-scope proof. The not-holding branch records a negative scope only when the body is refuted under current outer assumptions. Conditional witness coverage cannot settle Boolean proof. Candidate inference may once exclude known covered witnesses, then must reprove original scope impossible; a second conditional proof stays incomplete. Next: Include conditional Free/Local examples where one witness covers only part of caller domain.

Distinguish closed quantifiers from ones depending on outer variables. Existential proof computes body-plus-local-declaration support minus locals. With no free support, ordinary domain/existence proof may settle scope. Otherwise collect complete candidate witness families while retaining free variables rigid and tracking new nested locals. Next: Check outer-bound dependency policy and nested witness declarations together.

Cover an outer path with complete witness conditions. For each candidate, select logical local endpoints where permitted, resolve and validate a whole witness against its full signed relation, then union sufficient witness conditions. Refuting the complement of accumulated coverage proves existence; failing selected choices only returns incomplete, not nonexistence. ParamSpec/tuple packs require witnesses in their own domains. Next: Need reduced multi-witness coverage and rigid-free-variable cases before upstream solver design review.

Try bounded logical endpoints for local alias cycles. If selected local alias dependencies do not close, try effective lower endpoints only for ordinary local variables with matching selected peers and no chosen finite-domain constraint. The alternate still undergoes full relation/domain replay. Next: Qualify alternate witness replay while preserving ordinary inference defaults.

Apply logical binder domains separately from inference preferences. Validations.as_constraint_set combines upper bounds conjunctively and finite declared domains disjunctively. from_locals checks only declarations owned by binder; external dependencies remain free under outer validation policy. from_support excludes caller-inferable variables where requested. Next: Review inferred vs declared constraint provenance and free declaration policy tests.

Route empty validation continuations through the ordinary terminal visitor. Empty constraint lists call visit_node_and_then on ALWAYS_TRUE with callbacks, preserving common terminal behavior instead of directly invoking continuation. Limit errors retain their distinct control-flow wrapper. Next: Reconcile later 44 terminal-budget fix.

Do not export independent bounds mentioning quantified-away locals. Candidate construction takes explicit inferable and hidden support. Constraints overlapping hidden local support are excluded from independently exported mappings; actual private witness obligations survive in a separate residual. Next: Verify excluded metadata does not remove the full residual relation.

Preserve signed path and negative scopes for final witness replay. Signed path rebuilds ordered positive/negative atom facts and explicit negative existential scopes. Positive local candidates snapshot that signed path; negative-only candidates retain original logical relation plus negative obligations, avoiding accidental caller restriction from refinement splits. Residual records private locals, caller inferables and evidence policy. Next: Include split-refinement cases where callers satisfy both sides.

Exercise real incomplete upper proofs and cumulative witness work. Two complete assertion bodies: fixed upper generic callable comparison reaches real witness exhaustion and produces incomplete empty candidates with no violation; repeated existential proof consumes one temporary-type budget cumulatively, yet an independent true terminal remains certified. Next: Assertions read from source.

investigations.title: Recheck cached implications after branch rollback
investigations.summary: Python bugfix candidate. A sibling branch can negate a rolled-back consequence while its antecedents still hold. Retriggering cached rules detects the conflict.
investigations.nextStep: Reproduce against clean upstream and qualify both single and pair implication regressions.

findings.text: Recheck cached implications after branch rollback — crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/constraints/paths.rs

Recheck cached implications when a sibling negates their consequence. Single/pair implications register a trigger on false consequences as well as true antecedents. After a sibling branch rolls back a derived assignment, cached rules are rechecked when the consequence is negated, detecting conflict while antecedents remain true. This does not derive inference evidence from provenance-equivalent declarations. Next: Candidate for a reduced independent solver fix. Both complete native assertion bodies were read: single implication T=object⇒str≤T and synthetic pair.

investigations.title: Avoid violations from incomplete upper-bound proofs
investigations.summary: Python bugfix candidate. Exhausted generic witness proof must remain unknown instead of producing an upper-bound violation.
investigations.nextStep: Qualify the native exhausted-witness regression and reduce a Python diagnostic example.

findings.text: Avoid violations from incomplete upper-bound proofs — crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/constraints/solutions.rs

Do not report an upper-bound violation from an incomplete proof. inferred_lower_satisfies_upper_bound returns Option<bool>: Some true/false are proved; None marks unknown. Validation requires Some(true), while failure attribution stops on None to avoid fabricating a diagnostic violation. The real generic callable witness test exhausts temporary-type work and asserts no pending candidate/violation. Next: Qualify the exhausted-witness regression and reduce a Python upper-bound diagnostic example.

investigations.title: Check complete generic callable specializations
investigations.summary: Python enhancement candidate. Preserve strict callable relations while solving finite source domains, covering union inputs and comparing nested protocol receivers.
investigations.nextStep: Reduce strict callable cases; qualify domain replay and receiver progress against upstream #29555.

findings.text: Check complete generic callable specializations — crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/signatures.rs

Continue repeated declarations when finite receiver structure decreases. Recursion context tracks full protocol receiver pair. Explicit argument traversal includes finite aliases, generic arguments, union/intersection components but excludes recursive bodies/bounds/member expansion. Progress requires componentwise containment and at least one strict decrease, or same-origin target protocol requirement count decrease; unrecognized/growing contexts retain declaration approximation. Next: Validate well-foundedness for each progress branch and native nested iterable/protocol mismatch cases.

Admit only finite complete callable shapes for specialization. Specialization requires standard complete parameters, ordinary generic domains and no receiver constraints/ParamSpec-value shape. Static inference excludes declared domains; bounded/finite-domain path admits fully static or constrained Any forms with explicit domain checks, excluding Self. Next: Qualify finite caller admission for supported and unsupported signature shapes.

Cover each explicit union input with a valid source specialization. Unary overload aggregation expands target aliases, excludes generic target signatures, allows each target union member its own source specialization and verifies all overlapping source returns remain safe. This is limited to one required positional input, not arbitrary overload-set combination. Next: Reduce differing source specializations per discriminated input and unsafe overlapping return counterexample.

Infer unbounded static source binders while preserving strict relation semantics. Eager subtype/pure-redundancy comparison may enter LazyStatic for supported generic source and nongeneric target. Nested target generics or unsupported signatures decline. Existing LazyStatic is preserved through checker setup. Next: Compare finite caller admission and upstream #29555 nominal generic binding.

Replay complete bounded source specialization under the original strict relation. With no ambient inferable variables, source domain solving may propose bindings. Target variables stay rigid; incomplete paths/dependencies decline. Missing optional source slots may retain rigid source variables. Remove generic source context only after specialization, then replay original strict relation after search recursion entry is gone. Only complete rejected family can return false. Next: Extract bounded/finite domain strict callable counterexamples, gradual declarations and incomplete search gates together.

investigations.title: Infer implementation types from overload inputs
investigations.summary: Python enhancement candidate. Specialize generic implementation inputs before declaration coverage checks. Broader implementation return annotations are permitted; body checking has a separate owner.
investigations.nextStep: Correct the invalid nullable-return assertion, then qualify generic declaration consistency.

findings.text: Infer implementation types from overload inputs — crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/signatures.rs

Check generic implementation consistency using complete input-only inference. PrepareOverloadImplementation specializes implementation variables from rigid overload parameter inputs, never promised return/defaults. Generic methods, positional varargs, Self, missing input occurrences, indeterminate replacements, incomplete inference or unresolved remaining binders decline. Nongeneric implementation may compare rigid generic overload inputs within supported shapes. Next: Qualify generic declaration consistency independently of body checking, including fixed inputs and open keyword tails.

Reject implementation inference that silently drops relevant open keyword evidence. Only paired KeywordParamSpec captures infer tail evidence jointly. Otherwise implementation variables in skipped kwargs or named slots absent from overload fixed surface decline. Coverage then erases overload generic context to keep its variables rigid after implementation specialization. Next: Use fixed-input+open-keyword positive cases and hidden evidence negative cases.

investigations.title: Keep returned callable variables bound
investigations.summary: Python enhancement candidate. Preserve callable-local binders under outer substitution and project captured callback variables before they reach ordinary results.
investigations.nextStep: Reconcile binder ownership with upstream #29553 and #29555; qualify partial and captured-return cases.

findings.text: Keep returned callable variables bound — crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/call/bind.rs, crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/signatures.rs

Do not leak callback-local TypeVars into ordinary call results. After applying merged specialization, captured ParamSpec signatures upper-specialize their local binders in ordinary results while returned callable binders remain owned. Callback-local defaults must not choose escaped value types. Next: Native captured callback output/default cases required.

Preserve returned callable binders under outer projection. When preserve_callable_binders is set, locally quantified signature variables shadow an outer specialization including nested types, and mapping uses a fresh visitor root to avoid reusing transformation cache entries from the outer mapping. dfe forward changes replace this implementation with WithBoundVariables and must remain attributed. Next: Coordinate generic FunctionType #29555 and finite lambda #29553 binder ownership before extracting capture-avoiding substitution cases.

Expose declared/defaulted and upper-projected result views separately. Public APIs distinguish declared return, default-specialized return and signature-owned upper projection. Upper projection ignores defaults, preserves captured outer variables and protects binders in returned callable signatures. Next: Native source/default/captured binder examples before public API design review.

Retain unsolved generic binders in partial callable returns. Promoted partial variables select retained binder when unsolved, promoted override when inferred; other variables use inferred projection. This replaces overloading None/Some with explicit Retain semantics. Next: Extract partial return generic capture examples with unresolved dependencies and defaults.

investigations.title: Preserve viable generic argument expansion
investigations.summary: Python bugfix candidate. Keep overload expansion available when some generic specialization accepts an argument, including provisional arity mismatches.
investigations.nextStep: Qualify the bound-method starred-union fixture and reduce the generic expansion precheck.

findings.text: Preserve viable generic argument expansion — crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/call/bind.rs

Attempt argument expansion when some generic specialization can accept an argument. Expansion precheck changes forall-compatible to not-never-compatible under inferable TypeVars. A nonconstant relation need not be always true to have viable argument expansion; only proven impossibility permits skipping. Next: Reduce ordinary generic-overload union input case and compare upstream baseline.

investigations.title: Infer finite getattr results and empty defaults
investigations.summary: Python enhancement candidate. Use finite member facts for getattr results and fresh empty defaults. Immutable storage guarantees have a separate host contract.
investigations.nextStep: Reduce ordinary Python lookup cases; compare collection context with upstream #27665.

findings.text: Infer finite getattr results and empty defaults — crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/call/bind.rs, crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/call/checked.rs

Infer finite runtime getattr results without hiding descriptor failure. Known getattr resolves literal names/unions through runtime attribute policy, preserves missing alternatives, declines dynamic/indeterminate results and joins explicit default unless immutable storage proves it unreachable. Known hasattr returns true only on error-free immutable stored paths. Next: Split general finite-getattr precision from host immutable-storage default elision. Add descriptors that raise AttributeError and union receiver negative cases.

Contextualize a fresh empty getattr default from finite member facts. Only matched builtin getattr third parameter with complete static finite member facts and compatible nominal/protocol collection domains supplies preference context. TypedDict domains are excluded because empty literals may omit required keys. Actual default is still joined after inference. Next: Separate from ordinary lookup precision when reducing.

Require applications to establish native getattr operation identity. getattr_return_type declines binding errors/bound receivers and uses already matched object/name/default operands; host chooses actual native operation declaration and contract. Next: Verify the actual native operation declaration in every host caller.

investigations.title: Define keyword-only ParamSpec host contracts
investigations.summary: Host API design. Distinguish accepted keyword parameters from received keyword dictionaries, then verify complete ParamSpec witnesses against the original call relation.
investigations.nextStep: Specify host annotation and capture semantics before proposing shared solver APIs.

findings.text: Define keyword-only ParamSpec host contracts — crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/call/arguments.rs, crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/call/bind.rs, crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/signatures.rs, crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/typevar.rs

Distinguish accepted keyword parameters from received keyword dictionaries. ParamSpecProjection distinguishes ordinary attributes, keyword-parameter surface and captured keyword arguments. Accepted parameters have Mapping[str, object] bounds; runtime captured dictionaries and P.kwargs have dict bounds. Exact component mappings precede base substitution; a base replacement carries its projection onward. Next: Specify KeywordParamSpec host contracts and general ParamSpec component rules separately.

Retain optional keys and residual exclusions during argument binding. Observed keyword arguments keep source expression types plus exact snapshot entries and residual tail. Required names, expansion, key lookup and synthetic TypedDict conversion consume this metadata; ordinary source types remain available. Next: Include call-time mutation snapshots and optional/missing/residual examples.

Distinguish fixed keyword ParamSpecs from inferable empty captures. Caller-fixed ParamSpec keyword captures may require arguments even with no visible slots. Callee-inferable captures may resolve to empty complete signatures. Missing capture diagnostics keep correct base parameter ownership. Next: Review extension semantics separately from ordinary Python P.args/P.kwargs forwarding.

Substitute captured keyword surfaces without importing positional parameters. ParamSpec mappings project a keyword capture into accepted keyword-only inputs, preserve source receiver contracts and enclosing generic context, and decline unavailable projection. Forwarded ParamSpec helper unifies ordinary args/kwargs and host keyword capture paths. Next: Review KeywordParamSpec host extension independently of ordinary Python ParamSpec fixes.

Relate finite and symbolic callback keyword remainders. Lazy callable relation captures finite source remainder into readonly accepted-keyword shape, or relates symbolic tails only with equal fixed key sets. Add upper constraints on target keyword-parameter projection; positional behavior remains outside this evidence. Next: Separate host annotation design from general solver support.

Construct complete callable witnesses for keyword-only parameter evidence. Keyword projection handles positional-only prefixes and symbolic tails, gradual tails become incomplete keyword descriptions, top projects to Never. Closed TypedDict schema can propose a keyword-only ParamSpec witness; open schema declines. Fixed source names are excluded from remainders. Next: Only a candidate constructor: verify the complete original call relation before exporting inferred ParamSpec.

findings.text: Preserve synthesized parameter source locations — crates/ty_python_semantic/src/types/signatures.rs

Preserve synthesized parameter provenance through mappings and expansion. ParameterSource stores canonical Definition inline or shared FileRange for synthesized donor slots. Expansion, specialization, recursive normalization preserve source; definition accessor excludes raw-range sources. This supports navigation without inventing semantic definitions. Next: API design with source-location tests and normal parameter clone/size behavior.

Accept internal optional keywords while hiding them from presented signatures. Implicit keyword-only constructor adds optional Unknown default and implicit flag. Call checking and relations still include the parameter; display/index mapping consumes the flag separately. Mapping/cycle normalization preserve flag. Next: Keep internal inputs out of user-visible presentation without changing runtime acceptance.

Keep inferred default type with its original source expression. ParameterDefault::Source retains FileRange alongside inferred type, participates in direct/eager/mapped type access and recursive normalization, and public default setter accepts inferred/source-backed values. Named parameter raw default inference is split from existing signature cycle-breaking replace-default operation. Next: Preserve actual runtime source defaults vs donor optionality.
